title: A small family of small sets has a common regular cardinal bound
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$, a $\mathcal U$-small set $J$, and $\mathcal U$-small sets $X_j$ for $j\in J$. Let $X=\coprod_{j\in J}X_j$ be their coproduct in sets [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], realized as the disjoint union $\{(j,x):j\in J,\ x\in X_j\}$. There exists an infinite regular cardinal $\lambda\in\mathcal U$ with $|X|<\lambda$. Infinite regular means that a union of fewer than $\lambda$ sets of cardinality less than $\lambda$ still has cardinality less than $\lambda$.
